notes.title: Ophelia’s Chapter – Playthrough + Developer Q&A #2
notes.content:
[b]Ophelia’s Chapter[/b] is a story-rich, psychological-horror adventure game where you play as an urban witch with psychic abilities and delve into the mysteries of a world inspired by the work of Neil Gaiman and Stephen King.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457500/Ophelias_Chapter/

[h1]Let’s play the demo and chat [/h1]
Join us playing the game while discussing some of the mysteries and the lore of The Keys to the [i]White Pillar[/i] series. Get to know about similar games we love, our sources of inspiration and our influences.

[h1]Send us your Questions live![/h1]
We’d love you to send us your questions via [b]chat[/b] so we can have a meaningful conversation and find out more about the game or the team members.

[h1]Have a sneak peek of what we’ve been working on[/h1]
It’s your chance to get a glimpse of some of the haunted-surreal [b]backgrounds[/b] and [b]characters[/b] we’ve been working on lately, as well as new locations that do not appear on the demo.

Thanks for the support, please [b]Wishlist the game[/b] ;)

[previewyoutube=p-Sqy2i0Exc;full][/previewyoutube]
